categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and directly modifies wallet rescanning logic in src/wallet/scan.cpp.
categories.rationale: Parallelizing BIP 157/158 compact block filter evaluation directly addresses slow wallet rescans, a prominent user-facing pain point noted in the category rubric. Benchmarks confirmed by multiple reviewers show dramatic performance improvements, dropping rescan durations across 200,000 blocks from ~272 seconds down to 25–63 seconds (a 4.5x to 10x speedup).
